instructions: Keep the existing output layout. Stop project builds and preview servers before cleanup; this policy does not authorize removal. Preserve source media, databases, uploads, private configuration, and curated evidence.

rules.name: site-output
rules.instructions: Reproduce dist and thumbnails with npm ci && npm run build (or build:shop when intentionally enabled). Only these directories contain generated site output; public/assets outside thumbs is source media.

rules.name: review-evidence
rules.instructions: Review captures and logs individually; keep raw evidence private. Archive only selected evidence sanitized for secrets, personal infrastructure, and user data, with a dated index and provenance. Preserve curated archives.
